{{Top|leg}}
The '''M820 lubricant container''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[lubricant container]]. They could be used as [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] canisters if needed, but only if they were washed out with [[Berko-8]] and fitted with a different nozzle to allow connection with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] gas chamber.
